verdict.rationale: Brave maintains an official MCP server (github.com/brave/brave-search-mcp-server) exposing web, local, image, video, news search plus LLM context and AI summarization tools, with docs for connecting it to Claude desktop and other agent platforms. Minor caveat: community discussion notes ToS ambiguity around AI inference use requiring a separate plan, but the MCP server itself is officially supported and functional.
